attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 13 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. **The same day page also lists «Άγιοι Ευστράτιος, Αυξέντιος, Ευγένιος, Μαρδάριος και Ορέστης», whose Mardarius the corpus already keeps as `mardarius`; these are two entries on one calendar day and therefore two commemorations and two men,** and this one is the recluse of the Lavra of the Caves, dated by his own page to the thirteenth century. The page is two sentences long. It names the Lavra of the Caves and proposes no coordinate. It prints no hymn: it reports that his troparion calls him «μη-άπληστος», but does not print the troparion itself, so nothing is copied.
